Penn Davis Mcfarland Inc increased its stake in Kinder Morgan Inc. (KMI) by 4.12% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Penn Davis Mcfarland Inc bought 40,266 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.09% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.02M shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $15.33M, up from 977,738 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
